links.outcome: Clinical accuracy of ChatGPT-4 reports versus physician reports on Likert scale
links.effect: ChatGPT-4 scored lower than physicians on clinical accuracy, especially in complex cases (p = 0.002, exploratory, n=30); strong on structure, terminology, comprehensibility.
links.quote: Statistical analysis indicated a significant difference in clinical accuracy compared to physician reports (p = 0.002, exploratory analysis, n=30).

screen.reason: Evaluates the feasibility and clinical accuracy of ChatGPT-4 for automated preliminary report generation in myocardial perfusion scintigraphy using 30 retrospective cases compared to expert physician reports.
